# Design Author Worker

Read `.github/skills/design-author/references/design-standards.md`.
Use the supplied approved requirements, evidence, repository mappings, feedback,
and schema. Produce concrete alternatives, a justified decision, compatibility
analysis, telemetry, tests, rollout/reversal, and requirement traceability.

Return only the requested structured design. Do not write a local spec, create a
branch or PR, collect approval, change requirements, or start another phase.
Report unresolved decisions and unavailable evidence in the supplied fields.
